The '''Lifedetec bioscanner''' was produced by [[CryonCorp/Legends|CryonCorp]]. An instrument commonly used by [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] and security personnel, the scanner could detect the presence of lifeforms. The Lifedetect could also pinpoint their location, as well as determine what species it was as long as the profile had been loaded into indicators. The Lifedetec was the size of a [[portable computer]], and employed a shoulder strap for easy carrying.<ref name="Scanners" /> The Lifedetect was an early model of the [[EnhanceScan general purpose scanner/Legends|EnhanceScan general-purpose scanner]], which added communication, metal detection, and [[Motion sensor/Legends|motion sensor]] functions to the device.<ref name="WT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
